description: This bar chart illustrates F1 scores for two models, MADLLM and MADLLM w/o skip embedding, across five datasets: SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL. The horizontal axis displays the dataset names in the order SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, and MSL, and is categorical. The vertical axis, labeled “F1 Score (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 80 to 100, with tick marks at intervals of 5. For each dataset, there are two bars presented side-by-side. The bars labeled “MADLLM” are light green, while the bars labeled “MADLLM w/o skip embedding” are light orange. For the SMD dataset, the MADLLM bar reaches approximately 93, while the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bar reaches approximately 89. For the PSM dataset, the MADLLM bar reaches approximately 91, and the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bar reaches approximately 87. For the SWaT dataset, the MADLLM bar reaches approximately 94, and the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bar reaches approximately 88. For the SMAP dataset, the MADLLM bar reaches approximately 93, and the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bar reaches approximately 90. Finally, for the MSL dataset, the MADLLM bar reaches approximately 92, and the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bar reaches approximately 91. The bars are arranged in groups corresponding to each dataset, with the MADLLM bar appearing first, followed by the MADLLM w/o skip embedding bar. No bars are visually emphasized.
